Name: Cabin Entrance to PIF Door
Author: DragneelAce
Description:
This mod lets you turn selected [b]cabins into entrances for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20537]Personal Indoor Farm (PIF)[/url] rooms by[/b] intercepting the cabin's [b]existing entrance[/b] and lets it function just like a PIF door.

[heading]Features[/heading]
[list]
[*]Turn cabins into PIF entrances.[/*]
[*]Uses PIF's own room-selection system. [/*]
[*]Configure which of the 7 vanilla cabin types can function as PIF doors, while leaving the others as normal cabins.[/*]
[*]Supports configuration through [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] mod[/b].[/*]
[*]You can safely enable or disable PIF functionality for a cabin without losing the progress or contents of its PIF room.[/*]
[*]Multiple cabins of the same type can be assigned into different PIF rooms.[/*]
[*]Does not replace or modify cabin maps or tiles.[/*]
[/list][heading]Configuration[/heading]
Each supported cabin type has its own toggle.
For example, you can have:
[list]
[*]Stone Cabin = True (PIF)[/*]
[*]Plank Cabin = True (PIF)[/*]
[*]Log Cabin = False (Normal cabin)[/*]
[*]Trailer Cabin = False (Normal cabin)[/*]
[/list]This means you can decide exactly which cabin types should function as PIF entrances.

[heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley 1.6.15+[/b][/*]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI 4.5.2+[/url][/b][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20537]PIF - Personal Rooms 1.4.6+[/url][/*]
[/list][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][/b] is optional but recommended.

[heading]Important[/heading]
This mod is a bridge between [b]cabins and PIF[/b]. It does not provide PIF rooms itself.
You must have [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20537]Personal Indoor Farm (PIF)[/url][/b] and at least one of its content packs installed. Otherwise this mod is useless.
If you demolish a cabin, the PIF room associated with that cabin will be removed permanently. Avoid storing anything important in a cabin's PIF room if you plan to demolish the cabin.
The individual cabin type settings are intended to make the mod usable in multiplayer, allowing some cabin types to function as PIF entrances while others remain normal cabins. [color=#e06666]BUT I don't play multiplayer, so I have not yet tested if it works. [/color]

[heading]Compatibility[/heading]
This mod does not replace the cabin building or modify its exterior or interior. It simply changes the cabin entrance's door warp so that it will lead to a PIF room instead of their original interior. Since it doesn't modify the cabin's map, tiles, or interior, it should be compatible with pretty much any mod.
